description.value: Apple Tree Inn is a family-oriented motel tucked between Okanagan and Skaha lakes in Penticton, BC, offering kitchen suites and sleeper units alongside a seasonal outdoor heated pool and free barbecues. Its location on Skaha Lake Road puts cyclists within a short ride of the beach, wine country, and the broader Okanagan Valley touring network.

address.value: 2406 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 6E9
